label: Offer delivery date and time slots at checkout
name: slotsEnabled

label: Minutes a chosen slot is held for the shopper before checkout (5 to 240)
name: holdMinutes

label: Seconds browsers and the CDN may cache slot availability (0 to 3600)
name: cacheSeconds

label: Show shoppers how many places are left in each slot
name: showRemaining

label: Allow orders when the slot check fails unexpectedly (a full slot still blocks the order)
name: failOpen

label: Add the chosen slot to the order as an internal comment
name: orderComment
